name: A red stdio suite fails the attempt before the identity probe, and the suite is handed no store
description: The stdio suite recorded its environment and exited 1; the gate recorded suite-red. Its environment contained neither GATE_STORE nor LOYLY_ variables, and neither probe nor store-check marker appeared.
